en.headline: Hong Kong face Cambodia in ASEAN Challenge Cup final
en.dek: The first Challenge Cup final is this evening at Kai Tak Stadium, with FIFA president Infantino expected to attend.
body: Hong Kong play Cambodia this evening in the final of the first FIFA ASEAN Challenge Cup, at Kai Tak Stadium. RTHK reported a 6pm kick-off. FIFA's match centre lists the fixture at the stadium today.

Hong Kong reached the final with two group wins, beating Laos 4-0 and Brunei 2-0. Cambodia advanced from the other group with one win and one draw. RTHK noted that Cambodia won a friendly 2-0 in June, despite Hong Kong sitting higher in the world rankings.

Midfielder Wu Chun-ming told RTHK the team was determined to win the final and to answer that June defeat. He said the side wanted to play for the supporters, and that the shared aim was to lift the trophy at home.

FIFA president Gianni Infantino arrived in Hong Kong on Friday and met Football Association president Pui Kwan-kay and chairman Kenneth Fok, RTHK reported. He is expected to watch the final and present the awards. On social media he said he was glad to be in the city, credited the association with hosting the tournament, and called today's final historic.

zh.headline: 東盟挑戰盃決賽今晚啟德上演 港隊迎戰柬埔寨
zh.dek: 首屆決賽在啟德主場館舉行，港台報道晚上6時開賽；國際足協會長恩芬天奴預料入場觀賽並頒獎。
body: 首屆國際足協東盟挑戰盃決賽今晚在啟德主場館上演，中國香港對柬埔寨。香港電台報道開賽時間為晚上6時。國際足協賽事中心亦把今仗列於啟德主場館。
港隊分組賽兩戰全勝晉級，先以4比0擊敗老撾，再以2比0擊敗汶萊。柬埔寨在另一組以一勝一和壓過緬甸晉級。港台指出，儘管港隊世界排名較高，柬埔寨在6月的友誼賽曾以2比0取勝。
港隊中場胡晉銘接受港台訪問時說，球隊非常渴望贏得決賽，亦視今仗為報回6月一敗之仇的機會。他說一場定勝負不容有失，全隊希望為球迷而戰，目標是在主場捧盃。
港台報道，國際足協會長恩芬天奴周五抵港，與足總會長貝鈞奇及主席霍啟山會面，預料會入場觀賽並頒獎。他在社交平台表示很高興來港，又指足總成功舉辦賽事，今日的決賽將會是歷史性。
